versions.changelog: Switch to Twemoji 14.0.0 (complete version) with 3660 colorful emojis including all variants. Add Python script to generate emoji mapping table. Fix black-and-white emoji display issue. Support all emoji variants (skin tones, hair styles, regional flags, etc.). Improve mapping accuracy with pre-generated lookup table.
Initial release: Offline Markdown to PDF converter with full Unicode support, colorful emojis, and Chinese fonts. Uses Pandoc + WeasyPrint with local emoji cache from npmmirror.com.
